test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: There are seven members, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, in a family. H is the only daughter-in- law of D. E is the sister of C. C is the only son of F, who is the wife of D. B and G are the sons of H. How is G related to F?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given:

1) E is the sister of C.

2) C is the only son of F, who is the wife of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7124e61b87a8f4ac74e0d32e2d6969aaf29418d11f1bb42990bc26ebb0f406e6.png] 

3) H is the only daughter-in- law of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99344b37bae4ab3781d2cf7705b330fa8636ba1c42b2d5e65b8a6f129f8302b9.png] 

4) B and G are the sons of H. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60b9ca3f8199703304dbf72f87dae5bb8b0ffc5a5ddd9016b8c2a0a98b006b1f.png] 

**Hence, G is the** "Grandson" **of F**.
